fields.title: Onboard pumping and energy
fields.finding: 15–148 pump units arise from constant nominal-speed and 1000 W planning assumptions; this is not optimized or qualified hardware.
fields.proposed_fix: Obtain installed wet-speed curves near 32.5 Pa and a complete power/heat/plumbing design; recalculate changed barrier and power architectures explicitly.

claim: 15–148 pump units arise from constant nominal-speed and 1000 W planning assumptions; this is not optimized or qualified hardware. | Onboard pumping and energy
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
